[ASSISTANT_SAID] Grilling fruits and herbs can enhance flavors by caramelizing natural sugars, enhancing aromatics, adding smokiness, and creating texture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested fruits and herbs for grilling include pineapple, peaches, bananas, apricots, plums, mint, basil, rosemary, thyme, and lemons or oranges.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for grilling fruits and herbs include grilling over medium heat for 2-5 minutes per side, brushing with oil, and letting them cool before use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested cocktail ideas using grilled fruits and herbs include:  
- Honeydew Gin Fizz  
- Watermelon Basil Martini  
- Grapefruit Honeydew Spritz
